definitions.explanation: meat cut from the thigh or upper leg of an animal, especially chicken, beef, or pork

examples.japanese: {鶏|とり}のもも{肉|にく}を{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought some chicken thigh meat.

examples.japanese: もも{肉|にく}は{脂|あぶら}がのっていてジューシーだ。
examples.english: Thigh meat is fatty and juicy.

examples.japanese: からあげには{胸肉|むねにく}よりもも{肉|にく}を{使|つか}った{方|ほう}がやわらかく{仕上|しあ}がる。
examples.english: Karaage turns out more tender when you use thigh meat rather than breast meat.

notes:
Composed of もも (thigh) + {肉|にく} (meat). One of the most common meat cut terms in Japanese cooking and shopping. Can be written as {腿肉|ももにく} in kanji, but the hiragana-kanji mix is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鶏|とり}もも{肉|にく}: chicken thigh meat
- {牛|ぎゅう}もも{肉|にく}: beef round/thigh
- {豚|ぶた}もも{肉|にく}: pork leg meat
- もも{肉|にく}を{焼|や}く: to grill thigh meat
- {骨|ほね}つきもも{肉|にく}: bone-in thigh meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胸肉|むねにく}: breast meat — leaner and drier than thigh meat
- {手羽先|てばさき}: chicken wing tip
- {手羽元|てばもと}: chicken drumette
- ささみ: chicken tender/fillet — the leanest part of the chicken
